description: New UI features: logout confirmation, server folders, screen share expandable panel, downloads page enhancements, auth page polish, z-index/portal fix, and DialogDescription warnings. These are the larger additive changes, independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: ITEM 7 — Logout confirmation in src/components/SettingsNavigation.tsx: Add local state `const [logoutOpen, setLogoutOpen] = useState(false)`. Change the 'Terminar sessão' button to `onClick={() => setLogoutOpen(true)}`. Add an AlertDialog (import from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog') with `open={logoutOpen} onOpenChange={setLogoutOpen}`. AlertDialogContent contains AlertDialogTitle 'Tens a certeza que queres terminar sessão?' and AlertDialogDescription 'Vais perder a sessão atual e terás de iniciar sessão novamente.', AlertDialogCancel 'Cancelar', AlertDialogAction 'Terminar sessão' that calls `onLogout()`. Apply the same AlertDialog pattern to src/components/ProfileModal.tsx (the LogOut button around line 329 — wrap in AlertDialog) and src/components/SystemSettingsDialog.tsx (the 'Terminar sessão' button around line 373).

ITEM 6 — Server folder grouping in src/sections/ServerRail.tsx: Add type `ServerFolder = { id: string; name: string; serverIds: string[]; collapsed: boolean }`. Add state `const [folders, setFolders] = useState<ServerFolder[]>(() => { try { const saved = localStorage.getItem('tuga.server_folders'); return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : []; } catch { return []; } })`. Add helper `saveFolder(next: ServerFolder[])` that persists to localStorage. In the communities list render, group `orderedCommunities` by their folder membership: build a display list that interleaves FolderItem and server items. A FolderItem shows a stacked 2×2 grid of the first 4 server icons (each 50% size, using the existing icon rendering logic), clicking the folder toggles `collapsed`. Below an expanded folder, render the member servers indented. Context menu on each server button adds a 'Criar pasta' item that opens a small Dialog (state `newFolderDialogOpen`, `newFolderName`, `newFolderTargetServerId`) — on confirm, creates a new folder containing that server and closes. Context menu on a folder button adds 'Renomear' (inline edit), 'Remover pasta' (disperses servers, restores to top-level). For drag-to-create-folder: when a server is dropped ON another server (not an empty slot), if neither is in a folder, create a new unnamed folder containing both. Prompt the user to name it via a small popover/toast with an input. Persist all changes to `tuga.server_folders` in localStorage.

ITEM 5 — Screen share expandable panel in src/sections/CallStage.tsx: Add state `const [screenPanelSize, setScreenPanelSize] = useState<'normal' | 'large' | 'hidden'>('normal')`. When `showLocalScreen || remotePresenter`, conditionally render based on screenPanelSize. If 'hidden': render a small floating pill button at top-right of the stage ('Mostrar partilha de ecrã' with Monitor icon) that sets size back to 'normal'. If 'normal' or 'large': render the screen panel with dynamic classes: normal → `max-h-[72vh] max-w-5xl`, large → `max-h-[85vh] max-w-full`. In the overlay buttons on the screen panel, add three buttons alongside the existing 'Ecrã completo': a Minimize2 icon button ('Reduzir' — sets 'normal' if large, or 'hidden' if already normal, so it acts as a shrink-then-hide toggle), and a ChevronUp/Maximize2 icon button ('Expandir' — sets 'large'). Keep the existing browser fullscreen button unchanged.

ITEM 10 — Z-index / portal fix in src/pages/Home.tsx: Import `ReactDOM` from 'react-dom'. Wrap `settingsView` render: instead of rendering directly in the JSX, use `ReactDOM.createPortal(settingsView, document.body)` so it bypasses any parent stacking context. Same for `adminView`. This ensures Settings and Admin always appear above everything including motion-animated elements that might create stacking contexts. Import `createPortal` from 'react-dom'.

ITEM 13 — Downloads page enhancement in src/sections/SettingsPage.tsx: In the 'downloads' tab section (~line 1697), add two more platform cards: macOS card (Apple icon, 'macOS' title, 'Em breve' badge, disabled button) and Linux card (Terminal/Monitor icon, 'Linux', 'Em breve' badge, disabled button). Change the grid from `md:grid-cols-2` to `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4` to show all four cards. Add 'Em breve' badge using a yellow/amber styled span.

ITEM 15a — DialogDescription warnings: In every Dialog in src/sections/Sidebar.tsx that uses DialogContent but no DialogDescription (the 'Criar Novo Separador', 'Renomear Separador', 'Criar Canal', 'Edit Channel', 'Invite' dialogs), add `<DialogDescription className='sr-only'>...</DialogDescription>` inside the DialogHeader. Same for any dialogs in src/components/ServerSettingsDialog.tsx that lack a DialogDescription. Import DialogDescription from '@/components/ui/dialog' where not already imported.

ITEM 14 — Auth page polish in src/sections/AuthForm.tsx: Remove the bottom paragraph 'Ao continuar, acedes às tuas mensagens e servidores.' from the form footer. Make the left-panel background use a subtle gradient overlay. Ensure the form fields have `ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring` focus styles consistently (they already do). These are minor polish changes — the auth form is already well-structured.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking 'Terminar sessão' in Settings, ProfileModal, and SystemSettingsDialog shows an AlertDialog confirmation before logging out.
ServerRail shows folder grouping; folders persist in localStorage across page refreshes.
CallStage screen share panel has Expand/Shrink/Hide controls; hiding shows a restore pill.
Settings and Admin panels render above the server rail on all screen sizes.
Downloads settings tab shows 4 platform cards (Windows, macOS, Linux, Web).
No 'Missing Description or aria-describedby=undefined for DialogContent' warnings in console.
Auth page has no 'lorem ipsum' or filler text.
findings: All 7 steps implemented and verified. Build passes (tsc exits 0, vite builds successfully). Fixed JSX fragment wrapping issues in ProfileModal, SystemSettingsDialog, and ServerRail where AlertDialog/Dialog siblings were placed outside the return fragment. The Apple icon from lucide-react was added for the macOS download card. DialogDescription sr-only elements added to all dialogs in Sidebar.tsx and ServerSettingsDialog.tsx. Auth footer 'Ao continuar...' paragraph removed. Portal fix applied in Home.tsx using createPortal from react-dom.
